snippet.title: Fractured Blooms - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The Fractured Blooms demo is now live on Steam - a fresh out of the oven cozy life-sim in a horror time-loop.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4029780/Fractured_Blooms_Demo/

Inspired by a true story.

Restore your neglected house to its former glory by growing crops, cooking delicious meals, learning new recipes, and taking care of its inhabitants in this psychological life sim!

Wishlist now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3730310/Fractured_Blooms
